content:
dmitri: quick heads-up 12 seeing p99 jumps for embeddings during noisy multi-tenant bursts. digging traces: long batch_timer wakeups for low-volume tenants, looks like fixed timer is hurting tail. :thinking_face:

maria: which timer? we currently use batch_timer_ms=50 globally. that was chosen for average throughput but maybe not great for sporadic tenants.

alex: proposal: adaptive batch timer that scales with recent inter-arrival time (IAT). simple rule: timer_ms = clamp( round(avg_iat * 0.7), 8, 80 ). also allow tenant-level override for "low-latency" mode. pseudocode:
```
avg_iat = ema(client_window_iats)
timer_ms = max(8, min(80, int(avg_iat * 0.7)))
```

sre-oncall: telemetry implications: we must emit `embeds.timer.adaptive_enabled`, `embeds.timer.avg_iat_ms`, `embeds.timer.chosen_ms`, `embeds.timer.latency_by_timer`, and `embeds.timer.unit_delta_pct`. Alert if unit_delta_pct > 10% && p99 not improved after 30m.

zara: console UX: add a per-route "Adaptive batching" toggle and small panel showing distribution of avg_iat across tenants, chosen timer_ms heatmap, and a before/after units delta comparison. allow filtering tenants with >5% unit increase.

maria: rollout plan: feature-flag `embeds.adaptive_timer` canary 5% internal nodes. SDK header `X-Embed-Latency-Pref: low` to opt-in clients for forced low latency. default adaptive off for public tenants until metrics look good. collect 48h of metrics comparing p95/p99 and units.

sre-oncall: add `adaptive_timer.rejects` counter for cases where queue length > threshold and we fallback to default. also `adaptive_timer_fallback_reason` tag (QUEUE_HIGH|RESOURCE_PRESSURE).

ops-bot: feature-flag pipeline started: `embeds.adaptive_timer` -> canary (5%) -> will post canary reports here. :rocket:

zara: i'll mock the console card (timer distribution + unit delta) and post screenshots to the channel when canary starts.

dmitri: action items: alex - implement adaptive logic + metrics, maria - SDK header/docs, zara - console mock, sre-oncall - alerts/dashboards. reconvene after first 48h canary snapshot. :thumbsup:
